import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    ans = 0
    i = 0
    n = len(s)

    while i < n:
        j = i + 1
        while j < n and s[j] == s[i]:
            j += 1
        if ((j - i) & 1) == 0:
            ans += 1
        i = j

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
